blocks.text: Network performance ka matlab hai network kitna achha kaam karta hai. Yeh data ki muntaqili (transfer) ki raftar aur miyar (quality) dikhati hai. Achhi performance tez aur hamwaar baat-cheet deti hai. Buri performance se Internet sust hota hai aur deri hoti hai. Network performance kai cheezon par munhasir hai, jaise bandwidth aur latency.

Network bandwidth woh miqdar hai jitna data ek muqarrara waqt mein bheja jata hai. Yeh batati hai ke network kitna data utha sakta hai. Bandwidth aam taur par Mbps (megabits per second) mein napi jati hai. Zyada bandwidth ka matlab tez data transfer hai. Zyada devices zyada bandwidth istemal karte hain. Kam bandwidth se Internet sust ho sakta hai.

blocks.title: Bandwidth aur asal raftar
blocks.text: Bandwidth link ki zyada se zyada raftar hai. Asal mein jo raftar milti hai (throughput) woh aksar kam hoti hai, kyunke link bohat se devices share karte hain aur deri aur ghaltiyan bhi hoti hain.

Network latency woh waqt hai jo data ko safar mein lagta hai. Yeh data bhejne aur wusool hone ke darmiyan ki deri hai. Latency milliseconds (ms) mein napi jati hai. Kam latency ka matlab tez jawab hai. Zyada latency se lag (atakna) aur deri hoti hai. Online games aur video calls ko kam latency chahiye.

Network mein deri kai wajuhat se hoti hai. Bohat zyada users network ko sust kar sakte hain. Ghatiya (poor-quality) cables deri paida kar sakti hain. Devices ke darmiyan lamba faasla deri barhata hai. Network congestion (bohat zyada traffic ka rash) data ki raftar par asar dalta hai. Hardware ke masail bhi network mein deri paida karte hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Diye gaye manzar (scenario) mein deri ki mumkina wajuhat pehchanein.

blocks.prompt: Video call baar baar ruk jati hai halanke bari file tezi se download hoti hai. Masla bandwidth ka zyada lagta hai ya latency ka? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Latency (deri). Tez download dikhata hai ke bandwidth kafi hai; live video call ko har packet jaldi chahiye, is liye zyada ya badalti deri use rok deti hai.

items: Performance: data transfer ki raftar aur miyar.
Bandwidth: muqarrara waqt mein data (Mbps), zyada behtar; latency: deri (ms), kam behtar.
Deri ki wajuhat: zyada users, ghatiya cables, lamba faasla, congestion, hardware ke masail.
